acceptance: Identical typed fixtures serialize to identical canonical bytes and digests in Rust, TypeScript and Go; NFC and NFD text stay distinct, decimals, dates and instants keep meaning, and domain-separated digests cannot collide across kinds.

positive.fixture: 10 pinned canonical byte lengths, SHA-256 values and document digests match in all three languages

negative.fixture: non-minimal decimals, impossible dates, out-of-range instants, bidi controls and lone surrogates are rejected

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
performance_memory_storage: Pins are written only by the Rust authority (VSF_UPDATE_PINS) and verified by TS and Go.
